name: Battle Traits: Slaves to Darkness
abilities:
Pledge to Chaos: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly non-Unique Slaves to Darkness unit that does not already have one of the keywords below to be the target. Pick 1 of the following Pledge to Chaos keywords:
• Pledged to Khorne: 
• Pledged to Tzeentch:
• Pledged to Nurgle:
• Pledged to Slaanesh:
The target has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
Eye of the Gods: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase Pick a friendly non-Unique Warriors of Chaos or Darkoath Hero to be the target.
Dark Apotheosis: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase Pick a friendly unit with 8 or more Dark Apotheosis points to be the target. Pick 1 of the following.
*Aura of Chaos:* Heal(X) the target, where X is the number of damage points allocated to the target. In addition, the target has Ward (5+) for the rest of the battle.
*Daemonhood:* Set up a Daemon Prince within 1" of the target. Then, remove the target from the battlefield. If the target is your general, the Daemon Prince becomes your general instead and is added to your general's regiment. If the target has any enhancements, the Daemon Prince has those enhancements instead. If the target has a Pledge to Chaos keyword, the Daemon Prince has the same keyword. Otherwise, pick 1 Pledge to Chaos keyword for the Daemon Prince to have for the rest of the battle If any Manifestations that were summoned by the target are on the battlefield, those Manifestations are removed from play.
Pledged to Tzeentch: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Pick a friendly Pledged to Tzeentch unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. Then pick a point within a number of inches of the target equal to the roll. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units.
Pledged to Khorne: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Pledged to Khorne units.
Pledged to Nurgle: Friendly Pledged to Nurgle units have Ward (6+). If a unit already has Ward (6+), it has Ward (5+) instead.
Pledged to Slaanesh: Your Charge Phase For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for friendly Pledged to Slaanesh units, you can roll 1 additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do, you must discard 1 dice of your choice.

1 *Uncontrollable Power:* Allocate 1 damage point to this unit.
2 *The Spear Slumbers:* No effect.
3-5 *White-hot Varanite:* Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Gorbolga for the rest of the turn.
6 *Rampant Mutation:* The effect of 'White-hot Varanite' applies and this unit's Gorbolga has Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.
Blood of Molten Varanite: Roll a dice each time a damage point inflicted by a combat attack is allocated to this unit. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.
Roar of Domination: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

*Skull-gorger:* Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. If the roll exceeds that unit's Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain and you can Heal (X) this unit, where X is that unit's Health characteristic.
*Spell-eater:* Pick a Manifestation within 12" of this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, it is banished and removed from play. In addition, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned it.
Keywords: Rampage

name: Anvil of Apotheosis: Slaves to Darkness Hero
abilities:
Oath of Supremacy: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase If this unit is wholly within enemy territory and charged this phase, for the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Darkoath units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Myrmidon Rage: While this unit is damaged, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Chaotic Beast's Talons is 4.
The Bringer of Fire: Your Movement Phase Pick a terrain feature that has not yet been set ablaze within this Hero's combat range to be the target. That terrain feature is now set ablaze. Add 1 to this unit's control score for the rest of the battle (this effect is cumulative). In addition, for the rest of the battle, each time a unit (friend or enemy) ends a move within 3" of a terrain feature that has been set ablaze, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
Victor of 100 Duels: Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse this unit's challenge:
*Accept:* For the rest of the phase, when this unit and the target are picked to use a Fight ability, all of their attacks must target the other unit. In addition, for the rest of the phase, you can re-roll hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks.
*Refuse:* The target cannot use Fight abilities for the rest of the phase. In addition, you gain 1 command point.
Betrayed by the False God: You can re-roll hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target enemy Order units.
Rampant Mutation: Your Hero Phase This unit must use this ability in each of your hero phases. Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect until the start of your next turn:
1 *Rotting Skin:* Inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit. Subtract 1 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
2 *Brittle Scales:* Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target this unit.
3 *Bestial Tongue:* You lose 1 command point. This unit cannot use commands.
4 *Sprouting Tentacles:* This unit's Move characteristic is 2D6".
5 *Extra Eyeball:* Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks.
6 *Erupting Spikes:* Each time this unit finishes a pile-in move, pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
Reckless Arrogance: This unit cannot use the 'All-out Defence' command.
Spurned by the Gods: This unit cannot be picked as a target for the 'Eye of the Gods' ability.
Blood of Molten Varanite: Roll a dice each time a damage point inflicted by a combat attack is allocated to this unit. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.
Carve a Bloody Path: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick a terrain feature that has not yet been set ablaze within this Hero's combat range to be the target. When this unit uses the 'Power Through' command, inflict an additional D3+ 1 mortal damage on the target and add 3" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
Keywords: Rampage

Glimpse the Future: Deployment Phase Roll a dice. On a 1-4, the result corresponds to the battle round in which this unit will be inspired. On a 5+, pick a number. The number you picked corresponds to the battle round in which this unit will be inspired. While this unit is inspired, it has Strike-first.
